coverage_issues: The Qwen model failed to review '0000-fix-wayland-gtk-csd.patch' due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: The audit tool should handle LLM API errors gracefully, either by retrying the request or falling back to another model, rather than immediately marking the entire package audit as inconclusive due to a single file's tool failure.
